string.text: Tell me a joke.
Listen...
Not now.
Companion banter
Companions comment on what is going on: healing, fights, artefacts, weather, emissions and so on. The text comes as a message with a portrait.
Banter frequency
How often companions speak on their own. Normal: one idle line per 5-10 minutes. Lines for healing and revival are always said.
Jokes
Companions tell jokes when it is calm: more often at night, at a campfire and when you crouch. The dialog line works while this is on.
Voiced lines
If gamedata\sounds\cup\banter has a file named after the line (see banter_lines_for_voice.csv), it is played from the companion.
off
rare
normal
often
Hold still, here comes the shot. You'll be good as new, just second-hand.
Leaking again? You eat my medkits faster than canned meat.
Here's your shot. I'll bill you in loot.
Relax, I'm almost a doctor. I've seen it done twice.
I keep patching you up and you keep turning into a sieve.
Done. It'll heal before your wedding, if you live that long.
Injected. If you grow a third arm, that's not the medkit.
Stay alive. I don't feel like hauling the loot alone.
Wait, you're leaking. Let me wrap that.
Blood is supposed to be worn on the inside. Remember that.
Wrapped. Never promised pretty, but it doesn't drip.
Collecting mutants with that blood trail? Let me bandage you.
I don't mind the bandage. I mind you getting hit again.
Done. Want a bow on it or will this do?
You glow so hard the detector is blushing. Take the antirad.
A bit more and I could carry you as a flashlight. Injecting.
The Geiger counter is rapping on you. Antirad, now.
Where did you pick that up? Peeked into the reactor? Here.
Antirad. Tastes awful, but you'll have kids. Probably.
You shine like a New Year tree in Pripyat. Let's put that out.
Antirad going in. Keep the hair, it suits you.
Why so glum? Have some vodka.
Removing radiation the folk way. Bottoms up.
It's not drinking, it's decontamination. Drink.
No antirad, but there's a simpler science. Here.
A hundred grams and the roentgens take offence and leave.
Drink. Scientists argue, grandfathers have tested it.
Nothing to chase it with, so sniff your sleeve.
To having loot and not being seen. Drink.
Medicine. Forty proof by volume, no prescription needed.
Hold on! Don't you dare pass out!
Stay down, don't move, I'm coming!
Hey! Too early for you to meet the Monolith! Coming!
Just don't die, you still owe me!
Hang on, boss! I'll get you up!
Don't close your eyes! Look at me, I'm running!
Not again... Hold on, I'm coming!
Welcome back. There's no loot on the other side, I checked.
Up you get. Die on your own time.
Alive? Great. Next time, duck.
Get up, dust off, move. The Zone hates waiting.
You owe me a bottle now. No, a crate.
You're heavy. Lose weight or die less often.
Got you. But my supply of miracles isn't endless.
Breathe, breathe. How many fingers? Never mind, let's go.
It's beeping! I smell money.
The detector got excited. Either an artefact or someone dropped it again.
Something's shining over there. Hopefully not a bloodsucker's eyes.
Got a signal. Sidorovich is already rubbing his hands.
Found one! Now we just have to get it without getting fried.
Oh, loot. The Zone is kind today. Suspicious.
It beeps, bless it. My little breadwinner.
Got it. Still warm. Hope that's normal.
Yes! Hands intact, eyebrows mostly.
Took it. If I start glowing, call me a night light.
Loot's in the pack. We'll tell the scientists we found it on the road.
Pulled it out. The anomaly is offended but keeps quiet.
Mine. I mean ours. I mean I'll hold on to it for now.
Got the beauty. Now the main thing is to carry it home.
Done. They pour for free at the Bar for this. Once.
Now that was a warm-up. Who's next?
All down. I feel sorry for the ammo, not for them.
Clear. Let's loot while they're warm.
Good shooting. Shame they were shooting too.
And so it goes for everyone who doesn't say hello.
Fought them off. Didn't even break a sweat. I'm lying, I did.
Put half of them on my tab. Fine, a third.
It went quiet. I don't like it this quiet.
Boss, did you see that? No? Pity, it was beautiful.
Did you pack a backpack or rob a warehouse?
Boss, you're creaking. Is that your knees or your conscience?
Give me half before you fold in two.
With that load you won't outrun a blind dog. Or a lame one.
Decided to carry out the whole Zone in one trip?
Greed killed the stalker. Just a reminder.
Maybe drop the third canister? Fine, I'll shut up.
You walk like a pseudogiant after lunch.
You look bad. Worse than usual.
Boss, you're leaking. Do something about it.
Patch yourself up, will you? It hurts to look at you.
One more hit and I'm splitting the loot alone.
Eat a medkit. That's what it's there for.
You're starting to look like a zombie. Except zombies are livelier.
Get behind me, hero. Catch your breath.
Rain. At least someone in the Zone gets a wash.
Pouring. Counter's quiet, so it's drinkable. Kidding.
Wet again. Should have become a bartender.
I love rain. Nobody sees me crying over the ammo.
The weather is like a Duty man's mood.
A wet stalker is an angry stalker. Remember that.
At least it washes away the tracks. Ours and theirs.
The sky's going red. I don't like it. Find a roof!
Emission coming! Run for cover, philosophy later!
The Zone is angry. Let's not stand in its way.
Boss, time to go underground. Preferably alive.
It's about to blow. My knee aches before these.
Emission! Last one into the basement is a zombie!
My head is buzzing. Either last night or an emission. Let's hide.
That was close. Check that all of us are still us.
Alive. Brains in place? Mine seem to be.
It's over. Let's see what the Zone rearranged for us.
The air is fresh after an emission. So are the artefacts.
We sat it out. Now run for the loot before the others crawl out.
I wasn't screaming. That was a battle cry.
Quiet. We can come out. You first.
Getting dark. Normal people sleep, but we're stalkers.
Night. Perfect time for something to start howling.
Don't turn on the flashlight. Or do. They'll eat us anyway.
In the dark all cats are grey and all bloodsuckers invisible.
How about a campfire? It's warm there, and there are jokes.
The Zone is beautiful at night. Pity you can't see it.
Hear that? Me neither. Bad sign.
New place, new ways to die.
We're here. Never been here. Or I have and don't remember.
Watch your feet. And the sides. And up, too.
Well, hello, yet another hole.
I sense we're not welcome here. Same as everywhere.
Boss, is there a plan? Or the usual?
They say the loot is good here. And the graveyard is big.
Made it. Legs are humming, but they're all still attached.
If we get lost, not my fault. You held the map.
Walking, walking... When does this start paying?
When we get back, first thing is the Bar. Second thing too.
Boss, is it true Sidorovich has no legs? Nobody's ever seen them.
I keep thinking: the Monolith grants wishes, so why is the queue so angry?
If anything happens, I'm on the left. If it really happens, I'm already far away.
We're running low on canned meat. Just saying. For now.
Good walk. Nobody's shot at us for a while. I jinxed it, didn't I?
When I retire I'll buy a little house. Far from any reactors.
Do you ever sleep? Or is the Zone keeping you going too?
I want new boots. These remember the first emission.
Boring. Wish a flesh would run by or something.
Rise and shine! The Zone won't loot itself.
Slept well? I stood watch. Barely slept. Barely.
Good morning. You snore like a pseudogiant.
Awake? Check your pockets. Kidding. Probably.
Nothing happened while you slept. I'm surprised too.
Get up, boss. Breakfast won't eat itself, I checked.
Good morning. Or evening. You never can tell in the Zone.
Oh, started without me? Not nice.
Leave me some. At least to smell.
To luck! We're going to need it.
Drinking on duty? Respect.
Just don't sing afterwards. Last time a bloodsucker cried.
The boss is taking his medicine. Nobody disturb him.
Went down well? Then the second one's mine.
After the third one you see anomalies without a detector. Not guaranteed.
Boss, you crackle like a Geiger counter. Take something.
You're giving off warmth. The bad kind of warmth.
Got antirad in the pack? Good time to remember it.
You're glowing. Pretty, but harmful.
At least drink some vodka. I'm no medic, but everyone does it.
Step back a bit, will you? I still plan to have kids.
You collect roentgens better than artefacts.
So how's your Invictus going? Managing?
One life, boss. No spare in the backpack, I looked.
Just don't die. There won't be a second take.
With one life I wouldn't go into that anomaly. But you're the boss.
You only live once. You - literally.
Every day without dying is a record. Keep the streak.
A rookie comes to Sidorovich: "I need a job." - "Bring me an artefact."
"Where do I get one?" - "If I knew, I wouldn't be sitting in a basement."
A Duty man meets a Freedom man. Duty: "Halt, anarchy!"
Freedom: "Move along, order." They parted - both pleased, both offended.
A bandit stops a stalker: "Your loot or your life?"
"My life." - "Hey, come on, I asked nicely!"
A scientist asks a stalker: "How do you find anomalies without instruments?"
"With my foot." - "And if you miss it?" - "Then with the other foot."
A Monolith fighter prays: "O Monolith, give me a sign!"
A brick falls. The fighter: "Understood. Wear a helmet."
Two bloodsuckers sit in ambush. One: "Hey, can they see us?"
"No." - "Then why are they shooting at us?" - "They aim at the slurping."
A stalker complains to the barman: "Your vodka is radioactive!"
"But you need no snack. It lights and warms by itself."
A stalker finds an artefact and brings it to Sidorovich. He says: "Five hundred."
"It's worth ten thousand!" - "It is. In my hands. In yours - five hundred."
A Duty guard: "Password!" - "I don't know it." - "Go ahead."
"But I don't know it!" - "Mutants don't answer at all."
A Freedom man to a scientist: "Doc, the weed makes me see little green men."
"That's not the weed. That's a controller. Run."
A stalker walks through the Zone and sees a sign: "Caution, anomaly."
He walks around it. Behind it another sign: "Well done. We didn't write about this one."
Two bandits split the loot. "You get the tin, I get the artefact."
"Why's that?" - "Because I have a sawn-off and you have a tin."
Rookie: "Is it true a year in the Zone counts as three?"
Veteran: "True. Only not a year but a day. And not as three but as your last."
A controller catches a stalker, looks into his mind and sighs:
"Empty again. Just vodka and a debt to Sidorovich."
Scientists derived the formula of a stalker's luck.
Luck equals the amount of ammo divided by the amount of curiosity.
A stalker at the campfire: "Yesterday I took on a chimera with my bare hands..."
"Killed it?" - "Pushed it away. About five minutes. Then it got tired of laughing."
A soldier at the checkpoint: "The passage is closed!"
The stalker takes out money. The soldier: "The passage is closed. Behind you."
They ask an old stalker: "How did you survive so many years in the Zone?"
"Simple. I always walked second."
A zombie walks into the Bar. The barman: "What'll it be?"
"Bra-a-ains." - "Try the scientists. We only have vodka."
A Freedom man and a Duty man fall into the same anomaly.
Duty: "This is your mess!" Freedom: "No, it's your order: everyone in one heap."
Sidorovich tells a rookie: "Remember the three rules of the Zone."
"One: don't be greedy. Two: don't play hero. The third costs two hundred roubles."
A stalker prays to the Monolith: "I want lots of money!"
A voice: "Granted." He looks down - he's Sidorovich now. And can't feel his legs.
One blind dog says to another: "I see a stalker coming."
"You're blind." - "Fine, I smell him. Stop nitpicking."
A bandit to a mercenary: "What do you fight for?" - "Money."
"I fight for an idea." - "Which one?" - "That I should have your money."
A scientist: "We discovered a new artefact! It makes a man immortal!"
"Did you test it?" - "Yes. The lab assistant is immortal now. Nobody knows where he is, though."
A stalker comes to the Swamp Doctor: "Doc, will I live?"
"You will. But don't go into the Zone again." - "We're in the Zone." - "That's my point."
A notice at the Bar: "Will trade an Echo detector for two legs."
A note below: "Found my own. Thanks, no longer need the detector."
A Duty man reads the regulations: "Destroy mutants. Avoid anomalies."
"Freedom men... the page is torn out here and something's drawn on it."
A stalker finds a note in a stash: "The loot is in another stash."
He finds the other one. A note there: "Well done. Now turn around."
A flesh complains to a boar: "Everyone hurts me, shoots me, eats me."
The boar: "Then don't leave the anomaly." - "I was born in one!"
"Why do stalkers walk in pairs?"
"So someone can tell how beautifully the first one died."
The military dropped leaflets on the Zone: "Surrender, nothing will happen to you."
The stalkers thought it over and agreed: indeed, nothing would. They stayed.
A burer got a job as a loader at Yantar.
Fired after a day: carries crates well, but with the scientists still attached.
A stalker to a trader: "Does this vest really stop a bullet?"
"Sure. The previous owner never complained." - "Where is he?" - "Not complaining."
Freedom declared a day without weapons.
Duty came to congratulate them. With weapons. The holiday was rescheduled.
A rookie to a veteran: "What's the scariest thing in the Zone?"
"When the vodka is gone and the Bar is two emissions away."
An exam for the ecologists. "What do you do when you meet a pseudogiant?"
"Record observations." - "And then?" - "Then they record observations about you."
A Monolith fighter catches a stalker: "Do you believe in the Monolith?"
"I do!" - "Then go first through the Burner. The Monolith will protect you." - "I'm having doubts now."
One tushkano says to another: "Let's attack that stalker."
"There are two of us and one of him. Unfair." - "Fine, let's call forty more."
A stalker returns from a run, his wife asks: "What did you bring?"
"Myself." - "The cheapest thing again."
A mercenary gets a contract on a stalker. He arrives - the stalker is already in an anomaly.
His report: "Contract done. Subcontractor: the Zone. Please do not split the fee."
"What do an artefact and a salary have in common?"
"Both exist somewhere, both shine, and both end up with Sidorovich."
Voice language
Auto picks English voices when the game text is English, Russian otherwise.
auto (game language)
Russian
English
